catalystWatch.event: BTC Price vs. Realized Price Floor — MVRV Stress Test
catalystWatch.note: Realized price $53,448 (BGeometrics, 2026-11-18) is the structural floor for the Phase A mandate. If spot declines to this level, MVRV reaches 1.0 — historically a maximum conviction accumulation zone but also a signal of severe macro distress. A close below $53,448 would be an unprecedented stress test of the Phase A floor; below hard stop $51,844 would trigger mandate exit protocol.

brief.analystNote: BTC at $58,986 sits in a structurally compelling but technically fragile position: MVRV 1.104 places spot only 10.4% above the network's realized cost basis ($53,448), a zone that has historically offered exceptional 1-2 year forward returns for patient institutional capital. The failed auction low (sellers rejected below VAL $57,443) is the most actionable signal today — auction theory indicates seller exhaustion at this edge and favours rotation toward the 30d POC at $63,972, though two daily closes above 7d VAH ($63,700) are required to confirm initiative upside. Counterbalancing this structural support, the macro headwinds are real: 10Y at 4.91% creates a 5% risk-free hurdle, VIX 26.4 signals broad risk-off, LTH distribution at -15,710 BTC/day (7d avg, -0.374% liquid) adds persistent supply pressure, and ETF outflows of $231M represent a $495M negative swing from the institutional baseline. The CFTC's November 23 staff guidance allowing crypto to count toward exchange and clearinghouse reserves is an underappreciated structural catalyst — it lowers friction for institutional BTC adoption at a moment when price is near cost basis, creating a potential asymmetric setup. Recommendation: deploy 20-25% of the DCA reserve systematically into this zone per Phase A mandate, hold puts hedge given elevated VIX, and monitor the $57,443 VAL and $51,844 hard stop with discipline.
brief.riskWarning: A daily close below VAL $57,443 that is then followed by another close below the realized price at $53,448 would invalidate the failed auction low thesis and open the path to the $51,844 hard stop — triggering mandatory mandate exit and full DCA reserve preservation.
